lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance clusters organized in approximately three horizontal rows and five vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with circular clusters to form a structured Cartesian-like coordinate system across the visible mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, showing a high-contrast transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, horizontal, rectangular high-luminance anomaly is visible on the mid-posterior flank; a linear pale mark is present on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin surface displays a dense population of micro-scale high-luminance points that are significantly smaller than the primary lateral flank blobs.
